about.title: About me
about.p1: I'm a software developer focused mainly on backend, specialized in Java and Spring Boot. I currently work on the development and evolution of enterprise systems, working on features that range from APIs and persistence to security, document management and cloud services.
about.p2: I'm especially interested in solving complex problems simply and building software that can be maintained and evolve over time. I also have experience working with frontend, databases, AWS, Docker and automation of development and deployment processes.
